title: OJAJ etap I gram.-leks.: list do kolegi

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij list wyrazami z ramki. Kilka wyrazow jest dodatkowych i nie pasuje do zadnej luki.
tasks.text:
Dear Max,
I'm writing to you to ask 1. __________ advice. I have been 2. __________ for a job for 2 months but the only one I've found is 3. __________ L.A. It will mean moving far 4. __________ here. I really don't know what to do, I need 5. __________ advice from you as soon as possible.
Please, help me.
Ann
